definitions.explanation: Cold-blooded vertebrate animals with scaly skin that typically lay soft-shelled eggs. The class Reptilia in biological classification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{蜥蜴|とかげ}→蜥蜴：04305_tokage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爬虫類|はちゅうるい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{爬虫類|はちゅうるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変温|へんおん}→変温：noentry⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爬虫類|はちゅうるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一種|いっしゅ}→一種：01628_isshu⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Dinosaurs were a type of reptile.

notes:
{爬虫類|はちゅうるい} is the biological classification term for reptiles — cold-blooded, scaly vertebrates.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{爬虫|はちゅう}→爬虫：noentry⟧ (crawling creature; ⟦{爬|は}→爬：noentry⟧ = crawl, ⟦{虫|ちゅう}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ = creature) + ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (class, category).

EXAMPLES OF REPTILES:
- ⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧: snake
- ⟦{蜥蜴|とかげ}→蜥蜴：04305_tokage⟧: lizard
- ⟦{亀|かめ}→亀：02198_kame⟧: turtle, tortoise
- ⟦{鰐|わに}→鰐：04308_wani⟧: crocodile, alligator

RELATED CLASSIFICATION TERMS:
- ⟦{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}→哺乳類：04920_honyuurui⟧: mammals
- ⟦{両生類|りょうせいるい}→両生類：04924_ryouseirui⟧: amphibians
- ⟦{鳥類|ちょうるい}→鳥類：04927_chourui⟧: birds
- ⟦{魚類|ぎょるい}→魚類：04925_gyorui⟧: fish

USAGE:
Also used colloquially to refer to pet reptiles: {爬虫類|はちゅうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep reptiles as pets). Reptile enthusiasts and pet shops sometimes abbreviate it to ハチュ.
